fields.title: Completion-claim audit: require verified-by evidence before a ticket may reach done

handoff_package.objective: Implement ticket 7de9f4f0 (Completion-claim audit): require verified-by evidence before a ticket may reach done, so self-reported completion can no longer pass silently through the ticket store.

validation.outcome: all tests pass, including new coverage asserting a ticket cannot reach done without verified-by evidence
the audit path must detect and reject the empty artifact rather than accepting the successful write as proof
validation.command: spec_section_get on a section written as 0 bytes
